name: KLineChartQuant
description: DTCG Resolver Module 2025.10 entry point. Two orthogonal modifiers: preset (pro, exchange, terminal, zen, quant) x mode (light, dark). Scheme files carry both modes side by side under `light.*` / `dark.*`; preset contexts override those branches; the mode context is a generated selector that aliases the chosen branch onto the public names (`color.*`, ...). Aliases resolve after all sources merge (Resolver 2025.10 §resolution), so presets reach every mode without the modifiers depending on each other. Built by `pnpm tokens:build` (Style Dictionary v5 + permutation script, since SD resolver support is not shipped: style-dictionary#1590). Bundled: file sources inlined by `pnpm tokens:build`.

foundation.description: Mode- and preset-independent tokens: the legacy Theme families plus the v2 foundation groups.

sources.$description: Legacy Theme families (spacing / typography / motion) exactly as shipped in theme-base.ts. Theme-layer: emitted by themeToCssVars and frozen by baseline.test.ts.snap.

fontFamily.$description: 不指定字体，DOM 界面继承宿主页面字体。

fontFamilyMono.$description: 代码、版本号、数字等优先使用 JetBrains Mono，缺失时回退系统等宽字体。

0.$description: Chart panes, full-bleed panels, terminal personality. Basis: Basement square geometry (S14).

radius.$description: Radius scale (craft-principles §4.1; design §3.3). A nested element uses parent radius − inset, clamped to ≥ 0 (CP 11; S33). Radius tracks material, not whim (CP 12). Presets may swap the whole scale (Terminal square, Zen +2) but never mix scales; that mapping is Phase 3 (PresetPersonality).

xs.$description: Inner chips, badges, checkboxes inside 6px controls with a 2px inset. [derived] concentric rule S33 (6 − 2).

sm.$description: Buttons, inputs, tooltips, base surfaces. Basis: Geist base/small/tooltip (S3).

md.$description: Toasts, drawers, small cards. Basis: Sonner toast, Vaul drawer (S10, S11).

lg.$description: Menus, popovers, modals, medium/large cards. Basis: Geist menu/modal (S3).

full.$description: Pills, avatars, segmented toggles. Basis: rounded-full is Basement's most used radius (S14).

12.$description: Tertiary label, table meta. Basis: Geist label-12 (S4). Line-height [derived]: Geist gives labels "ample line-height for single lines" and copy more; rounded to a 2/4px grid (CP §4.2).

13.$description: Secondary label, dense UI body. Basis: Geist label/copy-13 (S4); Basement body 13/16 (S14); tracking Inter dynmetrics (S22). Line-height [derived]: Geist gives labels "ample line-height for single lines" and copy more; rounded to a 2/4px grid (CP §4.2).

14.$description: Default UI text, table rows. Basis: Geist copy-14 "most used" (S4); Carbon rows 14px (S29); tracking S22. Line-height [derived]: Geist gives labels "ample line-height for single lines" and copy more; rounded to a 2/4px grid (CP §4.2).

16.$description: Mobile inputs (≥16px avoids iOS zoom, S1), long copy. Basis: Basement blog 16/24 (S14); tracking S22. Line-height [derived]: Geist gives labels "ample line-height for single lines" and copy more; rounded to a 2/4px grid (CP §4.2).

20.$description: Dialog titles, section heads. Basis: Basement h4 20/20 -0.02em (S14); tracking S22.

24.$description: Page titles. Marketing surfaces may tighten to -0.03em (Basement h3, S14). Basis: Tracking S22.

32.$description: Landing section heads. Basis: Tracking S22.

48.$description: Landing hero. Basis: Basement mobile hero 46/39 at -0.04em (S14); CP §4.2 range -0.03 to -0.04em, design §2.4 display tracking -0.03 to -0.04em.

72.$description: Hero display only (72-98px). Basis: Basement h0/h1 (S14); display line-height ≤ 1 (CP 17, 45).

text.$description: Type scale (craft-principles §4.2; design §3.3). Tracking tightens as size grows (CP 17); label and copy are different roles (CP 18). 10px is removed; 11px is allowed only for mono/tabular contexts (axis ticks, meta). Weights: 400 at 12-16 and 600 at ≥20 per CP §4.2. Geist Sans/Mono are the target families (design §2.4); families are not tokenised here because canvas fonts (fonts.ts) are frozen (ADR 0005).

keywordDescriptions.numeric: Default font-variant-numeric for all numeric UI: prices, tables, axes, timers (CP 19; S1, S27; ADR 0004). Emitted as --klc-text-numeric.

11Mono.$description: Axis ticks, dense meta: mono/tabular only. Basis: Geist mono labels (S4); Inter dynmetrics +0.005em ≈ 0 (S22). Weight 400 of CP §4.2's 400-500.

fontWeight.$description: [derived] CP §4.2 allows 400/500 at 12-16; single-line labels take 500.

label.$description: Label role: single-line UI text aligned with icons (Geist Label 12/13/14/16/18/20, S4; CP 18). Sizes outside the scale (18) are dropped.

copy.$description: Copy role: multi-line text (Geist Copy 13/14/16/18/20/24, S4; CP 18). Pair with text-wrap: pretty (CP 20). Copy 14 is the default; 13 and 12 are secondary/tertiary (S4).

space.$description: Spacing scale on an 8px mini-unit: Carbon 2-160 (S28; craft-principles §4.3, CP 26). Dense app chrome lives mostly in 4/8/12/16, Basement's dominant gaps (S14). The legacy spacing.* family stays for existing consumers.

density.$description: Control and row heights per density (craft-principles §4.3, CP 27; design §3.3). Presets pick a density in Phase 3; users can override (trading-ui-benchmark 4.3.1).

hitTarget.$description: Minimum hit area on desktop: visual targets under 24px expand to ≥ 24px (S1).

motion.$description: Motion v2 (craft-principles §4.5; design §3.3). Animate only transform/opacity, never `transition: all` (CP 32). Chart interactions and keyboard actions (crosshair, pan, zoom, command palette) are 100+/day actions: 0ms (CP 31). prefers-reduced-motion keeps opacity/color and drops translate/scale (CP 40). The legacy duration*/easing* keys stay for existing consumers.

drawer.$description: Sheets and drawers; Vaul's curve, paired with dur.sheet (S10).

0.$description: Keyboard actions, command palette, 2nd+ tooltip (S7, S8, S9).

loaderMin.$description: Loading indicator minimum visible time (S1 range 300-500).

flash.$description: Price-update flash; off under prefers-reduced-motion (trading-ui-benchmark 4.4; design §3.3).

fade.$description: Price-update fade-out after the flash; off under prefers-reduced-motion (trading-ui-benchmark 4.4; design §3.3).

zIndex.$description: Named stacking layers, lowest to highest (design §3.3; ADR 0004 replaces raw z-index 1..1010). [derived] The order is design §3.3's own (no research source); numbers are anchored to current packages/vue usage so migration keeps today's stacking.

chartOverlay.$description: Overlays inside the chart frame; today 10-31 (KLineTooltip, MarkerTooltip, chart HUD layers).

dropdown.$description: Dropdown menus. [derived] first slot above sticky.

modal.$description: Modal dialogs. [derived] slot between popover and tooltip.

toast.$description: Toasts. [derived] slot between modal and tooltip.

breakpoint.$description: Viewport breakpoints (design §3.3). These are the project's own; the only research anchor is that the settings dialog collapses below 640 (trading-ui-benchmark 4.2.1). CSS custom properties cannot be used inside @media; consumers read them from JS (matchMedia) or mirror them in container queries.

sm.$description: Settings dialog collapses its left nav to a select below this width (trading-ui-benchmark 4.2.1).

brand.$description: Brand accent: Instrument Cobalt (ADR 0007; competitor-brand-colors.md §4, rank 3). Use sparingly: primary action, selection, focus, links, the MA line in preset previews. Market colors stay semantic: the accent never fills candles or volume bars and never encodes up/down (it sits close to the up color under tritanopia, ΔE 0.080). Not wired into presets yet (Phase 3).

accent.$description: UI, focus ring, selection (≥ 3:1). Blue category norm (Okhsl 261.4 / 0.971 / 0.509) with saturation only lowered 0.971 → 0.654; OKLCH 0.576 / 0.131 / 261.6. 4.10:1 on #151619, 4.05:1 on #F5F5F7.

sources.$description: Pro light scheme: the base values every preset starts from. Mirrors theme-light.ts and interface-colors.ts.

color.$description:
Light theme — concrete token values.

Color choices:

  - Bull (up) = a saturated green (#089981). Clears the WCAG AA non-text
    threshold (≥ 3:1) against #FAFAFA at 3.42:1.
  - Bear (down) = a saturated red (#f23645). Clears the same threshold at
    3.73:1.
  - Background = #FAFAFA (slightly off-white, kinder to eyes than pure
    #FFFFFF for long sessions).
  - Grid major / minor split: major lines for round-number price tiers,
    minor for between-tier rhythm. Both very low contrast (1.3:1, 1.1:1)
    so they don't dominate.

Indicator palette: ten qualitatively distinct hues using the Okabe-Ito
colorblind-safe set (extended to ten by adding three desaturated mids).
Each WCAG AA against the background (>= 3:1 for non-text).

MACD 柱与蜡烛遵循同一涨跌约定（base=Western：多头=绿、空头=红），
这样 withAsiaMarketColors 交换后即为亚洲市场「红涨绿跌」。

elevation.$description: Light elevation: shadow plus hairline (craft-principles §4.4; CP 13, 14). Shadow color hsl(220 3% 15%), a neutral tinted toward the surface hue (S19). ≥ 2 layers (S1); offset/blur double while opacity falls with height (S19); one light source for every surface (S19). x = 0 (light from directly above) departs from S19's 2:1 y:x example [derived]. Opacities [derived from S19's pattern].

hairline.$description: Every elevated surface also gets this 1px ring; border + shadow read crisper together (S1, S2).

accentText.$description: Accent used as text on light surfaces (≥ 4.5:1). ADR 0007; competitor-brand-colors.md §4.

sources.$description: Pro dark scheme: the base values every preset starts from. Mirrors theme-dark.ts and interface-colors.ts.

interface.$description: 图表、工具栏与 Agent 共用的冷黑界面配色；控件轻填充，行情与指标承担主要色彩。

color.$description:
Dark theme — paired with {@link lightTheme}.

Color choices:

  - Background = #0E1116 (deep but not pure black — pure black creates
    halation around bright lines on OLED).
  - Bull = green (#089981) — 4.97:1 contrast on the dark background
    (passes WCAG AA for non-text).
  - Bear = red (#f23645) — 4.55:1 contrast.
  - Grid is barely visible (1.2:1 over background) so it never competes
    with the data.
  - Indicator palette is the same Okabe-Ito set but with the few hues
    that need a brightness bump on dark background pre-tuned.

Same shape as light — only values change. The parity test in
`__tests__/themes.test.ts` enforces this.

Same hue ordering as light theme; values tuned for dark BG.
blue (brightened)

barUp.$description:
MACD 柱与蜡烛遵循同一涨跌约定（base=Western：多头=绿、空头=红），

elevation.$description: Dark elevation: depth comes from lighter surfaces first (color.ui background → surface → card; Material overlay ladder S31, Radix steps 1 → 2 → 3 S20; CP 10). Shadows remain only as soft transparent darkening, same layer geometry as light, never the only depth cue (S2, S31). Per-layer opacity [derived]: CP §4.4 gives 0.3-0.5; it falls as elevation rises (S19), 0.5 → 0.4 → 0.3, while added layers deepen the stack.

hairline.$description: 1px white ring on floating surfaces. [derived] midpoint of CP §4.4's 0.06-0.10 range (semi-transparent border S1; Basement off-white at 10-30% S14).

accentText.$description: Accent used as text on dark surfaces (≥ 4.5:1). ADR 0007; competitor-brand-colors.md §4.

preset.description: Visual preset. Pro is the base scheme; the others map a 14-field VisualPalette per mode onto the color roles.

pro.$description: Pro · 专业 — 原版基底 · 数据优先. The base scheme itself: no overrides.

exchange.$description: Shared role mapping for the visual presets (exchange, terminal, zen, quant): maps each preset's 14-field VisualPalette onto Theme color roles. Mirrors createVisualTheme() in presets/impl/visualTheme.ts; pipeline.test.ts proves the two stay identical. Pro does not use it.
